synopsis: SI 2026/867 amends Great Britain's machinery regulations, with the amendments taking effect on 20 January 2027 [f2217, f15491]. Chapter 3 identifies the underlying legislation as the Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008, SI 2008/1597, which remain in force in Great Britain [f2758]. The glossary notes that the amendment date coincides with the date the EU's new Machinery Regulation applies; the supplied facts do not describe the substance of the amendments [f15491, f2217, f2758].

relations.note: Both state that SI 2026/867 amendments take effect on 20 January 2027.
Both give 20 January 2027 as the commencement date for Great Britain's amendments.
Both state the amendment date; f2758 also identifies the underlying 2008 regulations.
